scores.evidence: The flowchart (s2-flow) is a vertical TD chart with readable Japanese labels at both 390px and 1440px, and the defs tables, prompt cards, steps and checklists render cleanly. However, the todo.html starter code (practice-starter) is clipped at 390px on lines 5, 15 and 21, and lines 14-18 are the highlighted ones (mobile-jp-19/20).

The lesson is long (35 mobile screens, 23 desktop screens), but there are no text-only screens and every section breaks up its prose with a defs table, a prompt card, steps or an inline check. Paragraphs stay short and no screen is a wall of text.

The lesson is Japanese only. Diagram labels, buttons and checklists are all in Japanese, and English terms appear only as glossed loanwords. Contrast is good throughout, nothing is hidden under the top or bottom bars, and the desktop JP chars-per-line median is 39 (target 30-40).

mustFix.issue: At 390px the todo.html code block cuts off on the right. Line 5 shows `placeholder="やるこ`, highlighted line 15 ends at `document.createElement(`, and line 21 ends at `() =`. The learner cannot see the end of the highlighted addItem body or the click handler without scrolling a box that gives no cue that it scrolls.
mustFix.fix: Keep every line at 40 columns or fewer while staying within the 25-line cap. Delete blank line 13. Split line 15 into `const li =` and `  document.createElement('li');`, as lines 9-12 already do, and widen the highlight range to match. Replace line 21 with `addBtn.onclick = () => {` and its closing `});` with `};`. Shorten line 5 to `<input id="new-item">`, or move `placeholder="やること"` onto its own indented line if a line is still free.

niceToHave: s2-flow: on desktop (desktop-jp-05.png) the edge label 「直したい点がある」 sits right on the two curved loop arrows between 計画 and 計画を読む. A shorter label such as 「直す」 would keep the arrows clear. On mobile it reads fine.
s4-table: on mobile, the bold 「直接頼みます」 breaks as 「直接頼みま／す。」 (mobile-jp-17.png). Shortening the item to 「…変更は、**直接頼む**。」 would avoid the orphaned character.
desktop charsPerLine max is 46, above the 30-40 target. The median is 39, so this is minor.
reader: the todo.html and terminal code blocks give no scroll cue when they are wider than the screen on mobile (known reader behaviour).
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (mobile-jp-35.png, desktop-jp-23.png). Known reader behaviour.
reader: the full-length mobile PNG stops at 16000px, and 13 /api/ requests failed in the preview environment (known, not counted as console errors).
summary: metrics.json has no hard failures: no overflow, no console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors, and no text-only screens. The layout is clean on desktop and mobile, the TD flowchart is legible at 390px, and no screen shows personal data. The one must-fix is the todo.html starter code (practice-starter), which is cut off on the right at 390px, including the highlighted addItem lines. Rewrap it so every line fits in 40 columns.
